title: When the Rebuild of a Customer Specification Remake Starts — Factory Production Orders Order Desk
content:
**Ruling.** For Factory Production Orders, the rebuild start date of a customer specification remake is set by when the corrected specification was confirmed:

1. when the order carries an acknowledgment signature dated after that remake (the corrected acknowledgment for the remade units), the rebuild starts on the date of the most recent such signature;
2. when there is none and the most recent glass received checkpoint on the order is dated after the remake (replacement glass for the remade units), the rebuild starts on that glass received date;
3. otherwise it starts on the remake date.

The remake meant is the most recent remake on the order recorded with cause customer specification error.

## Records read

All three dates come from the order's milestone records: the remake record's date, the acknowledgment signed checkpoints, and the glass received checkpoints. "After the remake" means dated later than the remake date; a checkpoint dated the same day as the remake is not after it.

## Conditions in combination

| Signature dated after the remake | Most recent glass received dated after the remake | Rebuild starts on |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the most recent such signature date |
| yes | no | the most recent such signature date |
| no | yes | that glass received date |
| no | no | the remake date |

## Hypothetical cases

- Remake on 3 March; corrected acknowledgment signed 7 March; glass received 10 March. The rebuild starts on 7 March.
- Remake on 3 March; the only acknowledgment signature is dated in January; glass received 6 March. The rebuild starts on 6 March.
- Remake on 3 March; no signature or glass received checkpoint after it. The rebuild starts on 3 March.
